title: Cute BUT....
text: Cute BUT..... They came early, but see,I know they're cheap, but seriously?! The stitches they use to keep the legs together are stitched wrong, they are not aligned right so therefore they sit not so even. If I attempted to pull the stitch to fix it,it will rip... So yea cute,but not done right. But who knows? Maybe their not all like that.
